bullets.text: Under supervision, implemented reusable Python modules for the project workflow and wrote pytest regression tests for malformed and edge-case inputs as an individual contribution to the team project.
Under supervision, applied a documented topic dictionary to provided public news summary samples using NLTK and checked dictionary matches against manually reviewed examples.
Under supervision, joined document identifiers to publication metadata using SQL and checked unmatched records; visualized group comparisons with Matplotlib and documented missing-data handling.
